# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do **not** open a public issue for security reports. Email the maintainer
with details and reproduction steps; you'll get an acknowledgement within 72 hours
and a remediation timeline after triage.

## Scope

The backend (`/backend`) and its deployment configuration. See
`backend/docs/SECURITY.md` for the threat model and implemented controls.

## Supported versions

The `main` branch receives security fixes. Pre-release branches are best-effort.
